description_en: Queries the database connection information of an ApsaraDB for HBase instance by calling DescribeEndpoints
description_zh: 调用DescribeEndpoints查询HBase实例的数据库连接信息
name: DescribeEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that you want to query. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的实例ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html接口获取
parameters.name: cluster_id

ConnType.description_en:
The connection type. Valid values:
uiProxyConn: UI access connection.
zkConn: ZooKeeper connection.
thriftConn: Thrift connection.
slbConn_thrift: load balancing Thrift connection.
serviceConn_LivyConnAddr: Livy connection
ConnType.description_zh:
连接的类型，返回值：
uiProxyConn：UI访问连接。
zkConn：ZK连接。
thriftConn：thrift连接。
slbConn_thrift：负载均衡的thrift连接。
serviceConn_LivyConnAddr： livy连接

NetType.description_en:
The network type of the connection. Valid values:
PUBLIC or 0: public network access.
PRIVATE or 1: internal-facing access.
VPC or 2: VPC access
NetType.description_zh:
连接的访问网络类型，返回值：
PUBLIC或0：表示公网访问。
PRIVATE或1：表示私网访问。
VPC或2：表示VPC访问

Engine.description_en:
The engine type of the instance. Valid values:

hbaseue
hbase
spark
geomesa
Engine.description_zh:
实例引擎类型，返回值：

hbaseue
hbase
spark
geomesa

NetType.description_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:
VPC: virtual private cloud.
CLASSIC: classic network
NetType.description_zh:
实例的网络类型，返回值：
VPC：专有网络类型。
CLASSIC：经典网络类型

VSwitchId.description_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is returned only when NetType is set to VPC
VSwitchId.description_zh: 虚拟交换机ID，当NetType为VPC时会返回此参数

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID. This parameter is returned only when NetType is set to VPC
VpcId.description_zh: 专有网络ID，当NetType为VPC时会返回此参数
